summary.description: One or two short sentences in plain English for a busy parent: what the request is and what you think of it.

brief.description: 3 to 5 short lines: what will be built if this goes ahead, as you would explain it to the parent. Anything here that the request does not say must also be listed as an assumption.

decided.description: Only points the owner settled in replies to an earlier idea check, one short line each. Empty if there are none.

findings.description: Labelled findings. Empty if the request is clear and fits the rules.

detail.description: For a question: the question. For a problem: what clashes, naming the decision (e.g. D14). For an assumption: why it is needed. Otherwise: what you suggest.

options.description: For a question (or a problem): 2 to 4 short options the owner can pick by letter.

default.description: For an assumption: what the builder will do unless the owner says otherwise.
